note: WAEC Islamic Studies round 6 (R31 top-up): gradual revelation and Makkan themes; asbab al-nuzul, tafsir, tajwid; sahih and mawdu' grades; Sunnah after the Qur'an; Ar-Rahman, Israfil, kiraman katibin, Tawrat; sujud as-sahw, khushu', iqamah; Ramadan and the Qur'an, zakah as cleanser; hajj conditions and ihram months; al-Amin, Negus of Abyssinia, Umar's open prayer, Sahifah of Madinah, mu'akhah, Quba, Yarmuk; Bilal first muezzin; fitnah after Uthman; maisir, ihtikar, bribery, tampered scales, mothers; Usman dan Fodio and Sokoto; lunar year's eleven days; fiqh, ijma', qiyas. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-5, NECO IRS (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
